title: ESP32-S3 Dual-Core FreeRTOS: MAVLink Bridge + Onboard CV is Feasible
context: Avatar's ESP32-S3 is currently a serial-to-UDP bridge only, using ~5% CPU. It has 8MB PSRAM and AI acceleration unused.
what_was_found: esp32-flight-controller proves FreeRTOS dual-core on ESP32: Core 0 (sensors/status), Core 1 (motor PID at 50Hz, radio at 500Hz, GPS at 1Hz). esp-drone flow deck runs PMW3901 at 100-200Hz consuming ~5-10% CPU. ESP32-S3 has 2x compute + ESP-NN AI acceleration (7.2x convolution speedup).
proposed_architecture: Core 0: WiFi + UDP + MAVLink + WebSocket. Core 1: Camera capture → HSV blob tracking → centroid UDP at 15-30Hz. This reduces tracking latency from ~150ms (MacBook round-trip) to <30ms.
action: Phase 1: Port avatar_bridge.ino from Arduino to ESP-IDF with FreeRTOS. Phase 2: Add ESP32-CAM + HSV blob tracker on Core 1.
